title: Replacement of existing Storm Signal Mast by new one at Puri Storm Signal Centre, Odisha.
summary: Online two-bid e-tender for replacing the existing storm signal mast with a new one at the Puri Storm Signal Centre in Odisha, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Puri Storm Signal Centre, Odisha
sites.work: Replacement of existing storm signal mast by new one

scope.item: Replacement of existing Storm Signal Mast by new one

money.notes: EMD by Demand Draft / FDR / bank guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; EMD exemption not allowed; original EMD to reach office by 05/09/2024. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in Building civil work category with Central Govt. department/undertaking/autonomous body or State Govt.

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar works = repairs & maintenance or construction of any type of building works (RCC or masonry); values updated at 7% simple per annum
Notarized affidavit (2024) of not being blacklisted/debarred by any Central/State government organization
Undertaking on letter pad that price bid is unconditional
Tender acceptance letter on bidder's letter pad as per format; other documents as per Section VI
notes: Only the 4-page bilingual NIT (printed page numbers 3-6); no BOQ, drawings or mast specification. Hindi location field reads 'Paradip, Odisha' while the English reads 'Puri, Odisha' (title and work name say Puri). Bid download/submission 21/08/2024 10:00 to 05/09/2024 15:00; technical bid opening 06/09/2024 16:00; pre-bid meeting 02/09/2024 15:00. Bidders requested to visit site. Storm Signal Centre is not matched to Puri Lighthouse station id.
